turns.reply: The three HTML export tests now fail only because they assert the old exact markup. That is expected from this template change, and I can't edit test files. Submitting.

I fixed the HTML export template in `rich/_export_format.py`: `<html>` now comes before `<head>` instead of after `</head>`, and the `<code>` element gets `style="font-family:inherit"`.

Three existing tests in `tests/test_console.py` (`test_export_html`, `test_export_html_inline`, `test_save_html`) now fail because they assert the old exact markup. I didn't update them, since test files are off-limits. The issue text didn't spell out the expected output, so I went from memory of the upstream fix; the `font-family:inherit` attribute is the part I'm least sure of.

I did not make the `.pre-commit-config.yaml` update the PR description mentions, because it isn't a source change.
